_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (4 March 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (ended Labour control held since 2010) and formed the Cabinet 20 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (34 of 46), ending Labour control held since 2010. Leader Cllr George Woodward (appointed 20 May 2026). Two Deputy Leaders (Gibson + Roughley). Part of the Liverpool City Region Combined Authority (Mayor Steve Rotheram, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114/EFS/BVN). DSG High Needs deficit overspend GBP 11.717m held in a ring-fenced reserve, no revenue impact.
mtfs._source: St Helens 2026/27 Council Tax Report (s176176) + leaflet, full Council 4 Mar 2026, pulled and read directly. Net budget estimated (4 Mar budget report not pulled).
